test.fill_query: INSERT INTO map_keys_filter_only_perf SELECT number AS id, mapFromArrays( arrayMap(i -> if(number < 10000 AND i = 15, 'target_key', concat('k', toString(i))), range(16)), arrayMap(i -> concat( hex(cityHash64(number, i, 1)), hex(cityHash64(number, i, 2)), hex(cityHash64(number, i, 3)), hex(cityHash64(number, i, 4))), range(16))) AS m FROM numbers_mt(1000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE map_keys_filter_only_perf FINAL SETTINGS mutations_sync=1

INSERT INTO map_values_filter_only_perf SELECT number AS id, mapFromArrays( arrayMap(i -> concat( hex(cityHash64(number, i, 1)), hex(cityHash64(number, i, 2)), hex(cityHash64(number, i, 3)), hex(cityHash64(number, i, 4))), range(16)), arrayMap(i -> if(number < 10000 AND i = 15, 'target_value', concat('v', toString(i))), range(16))) AS m FROM numbers_mt(1000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE map_values_filter_only_perf FINAL SETTINGS mutations_sync=1
